name: Sumo Classic Craft: World of CarrickCraft
description: Eight original carved sumo guardians from World of CarrickCraft, the genesis NFT collection of Sumo Classic Craft. Each artwork represents a distinct realm and is prepared for permanent storage on IPFS through Pinata.

items.name: Carrick Vale
items.description: The first guardian watches over emerald terraces and the dawn dohyo where every CarrickCraft journey begins.

items.name: Whispering Marsh
items.description: A silent wooden sentinel stands among lantern-lit reeds, moonlit water, and the marsh's oldest secrets.

items.name: Emberpeak
items.description: Stone armor and molten veins define the formidable guardian of CarrickCraft's volcanic summit.

items.name: Far Rift
items.description: Beyond the floating obsidian shards, a celestial keeper holds the boundary between the holds and the void.

items.name: Goldcrest Harbor
items.description: The harbor keeper welcomes every sail beneath copper lanterns and the warm light of a golden sunset.

items.name: Atlas of Nine Holds
items.description: A wise cartographer tends the floating atlas and preserves the stories connecting all nine CarrickCraft holds.

items.name: Frostveil
items.description: Crystalline armor and a quiet resolve protect the frozen forests and waterfalls of the northern reach.

items.name: Palmreach
items.description: A joyful guardian welcomes travelers to a tropical sanctuary of bright flowers, waterfalls, and turquoise water.
